Notice of Motion
16.a
Councillor W. Mazur put forth the following Notice of Motion:
WHEREAS Provincial and municipal housing initiatives increasingly encourage a greater range of housing options, including additional residential units and higher-density residential development;
AND WHEREAS these evolving housing densities may increase residential parking demands while limiting off-street parking availability, warranting a review of existing parking regulations to ensure they continue to meet the needs of residents while maintaining public safety and neighbourhood livability;
NOW THEREFORE BE IT RESOLVED that Woodstock City Council direct staff to undertake a review of the City's residential on-street parking regulations, including existing five-hour and overnight parking restrictions;
AND FURTHER that the review consider options to provide greater flexibility for residents, including but not limited to residential parking permits, exemptions for specific residential circumstances, and other parking management tools utilized by comparable Ontario municipalities;
AND FURTHER that staff evaluate the operational, financial, enforcement, and neighbourhood impacts associated with any proposed changes, including considerations related to winter maintenance operations, curbside waste collection, emergency vehicle access, traffic safety, and impacts on adjacent properties;
AND FURTHER that staff report back to Council with findings and recommendations by end of Q2 2027.
